name: Roda de Berà (Spain)
description: Dark blue field with a white disc at the centre bearing the yellow Arch of Berà.
history: The official flag of Roda de Berà is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, dark blue, with a white disc at the centre of diameter 2/3 of the height of the cloth bearing the yellow arch of Berà of height 1/3; approved on 19 September 2003 and published in the DOGC.

features.role: Roman arch of Berà on the disc
